issues.description: The template's Main.java calls farm.feed() (commented), but the problem statement and solution use the method name feedAllAnimals(). This mismatch in the expected farm method name can confuse students about which method to implement and whether a feed() method is required by the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the specification: update template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() (or change the exercise text to accept feed()). Alternatively, add a farm.feed() method in the template Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals() to maintain backward compatibility.

issues.description: The problem statement and solution use the method name feedAllAnimals() for feeding all animals, but the template Main.java example calls farm.feed(). This inconsistent naming for the same conceptual operation (feeding all animals) can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template example consistent with the problem and solution by replacing the call to farm.feed() with farm.feedAllAnimals() in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java, or add a feed() delegating method in Farm that calls feedAllAnimals() to preserve the example while aligning names.
